Documentation

Pre-Defined Sections

  • template - for storing templates for the page that the rendering engine can use if the app allows it. An id fields must exist for the engine to pick it up.

  • metadata - page metadata. The -- template: will override the default processing template.

  • title - Title section for the page. The first block is treated as an h1 title by default that goes inside an hgroup tag. an optional -- subtitle: attribute can be added which will populate in the hgroup as well.
